purpose: Türkçe, çevrimdışı ve salt okunur JSON/SHA256 dosya bütünlüğü kontrolü; tüm projelere uygulanabilir.
cli: python <entry> MANIFEST --root ROOT --json; default language Turkish, optional --lang tr|en

output.message: Turkish by default; integrity only, no semantic acceptance claim
output.files: array of relative paths and per-file status OK|MISMATCH|MISSING|SIZE_MISMATCH|INVALID_PATH|ERROR

exitCodes.0: all nonempty listed files match exact raw SHA256 and optional bytes
exitCodes.1: missing, mismatch, size mismatch or unreadable file
exitCodes.2: invalid manifest/path/type/duplicate/empty list or CLI error

constraints: No input mutation, network, secret reading, subprocess, dependency, daemon or external server
Root explicit CLI selection; never follow manifest root field as authority
Reject absolute/drive/UNC/parent escape; resolved files must stay within selected root
Do not silently normalize bytes or line endings
Preserve the prewritten oracle and contract unchanged
Skill package must run only on user-selected supplied files and must not mint acceptance/identity/publication
existingToolsAndGap: GNU sha256sum already checks hashes; Python hashlib supplies the algorithm. This small stdlib wrapper adds existing JSON catalogue compatibility, relative-path diagnostics, size checks, Turkish report and a portable skill; no replacement for a source review or OS sandbox.
